metadata.description: Major global ports with city, country, type, and annual throughput data
metadata.usage: Used by exposure mapper to resolve port names to geographic anchors and by query generator to build port-specific queries

Port of Shanghai.strategic_importance: World's busiest container port; gateway for China exports

Port of Singapore.strategic_importance: Transshipment hub for Southeast Asia; controls Malacca Strait exit

Port of Ningbo-Zhoushan.strategic_importance: China's second busiest port; key for automotive and bulk cargo

Port of Shenzhen.strategic_importance: Gateway for Guangdong electronics exports; serves Foxconn and Pearl River Delta

Port of Guangzhou.strategic_importance: Pearl River Delta export hub; serves automotive and manufacturing

Port of Qingdao.strategic_importance: Key north China port; major iron ore import terminal

Port of Busan.strategic_importance: Northeast Asia transshipment hub; gateway for Korean exports

Port of Rotterdam.strategic_importance: Europe's largest port; primary gateway for European imports/exports

Port of Antwerp.strategic_importance: Europe's second largest port; major chemicals and automotive hub

Port of Kaohsiung.strategic_importance: Taiwan's primary export port; critical for semiconductor and electronics exports

Port of Hamburg.strategic_importance: Germany's largest port; gateway for Central European trade

Port of Los Angeles.strategic_importance: US gateway for trans-Pacific trade; key electronics import port

Port of Long Beach.strategic_importance: Adjacent to LA Port; combined they handle 40% of US imports

Port of Yokohama.strategic_importance: Tokyo Bay gateway; key for Japanese automotive exports

Port of Nagoya.strategic_importance: Japan's busiest port by cargo value; primary automotive export port (Toyota)

Port of Chennai.strategic_importance: India's automotive export hub; gateway for South India manufacturing

Port of Mumbai.strategic_importance: India's largest container port; handles 55% of India's container traffic

Port of Jebel Ali.strategic_importance: Middle East's largest port; major transshipment hub between Asia and Europe

Port of Klang.strategic_importance: Malaysia's primary port; gateway for Penang electronics exports

Port of Laem Chabang.strategic_importance: Thailand's primary deep-sea port; serves Eastern Economic Corridor

Port of Colombo.strategic_importance: South Asia transshipment hub; critical for India-Europe trade route

Port of Ras Laffan.strategic_importance: World's largest LNG export terminal; supplies 30%+ of global LNG

Port of Felixstowe.strategic_importance: UK's largest container port; handles 48% of UK container trade
